_comment: NOTE: settings.json has NO mcpServers field in its schema — a definition
here is silently ignored. The dev whiteboard MCP server is a LOCAL-scope
claude mcp add --scope local --transport stdio whiteboard -- \
which shadows .mcp.json's published npx definition (local > project).
.mcp.json is the public plugin surface — do not repoint it at dev tooling.
See AGENTS.md 'MCP Development Mode' and docs/contributing/mcp-debugging.md.

hooks._comment: ensure-http-dev-daemon waits up to 30s for `pnpm mcp:http:dev` to bind on cold checkouts; keep this timeout above that so the hook is not killed mid-wait.
Blocks `gh pr create` when the branch is behind a freshly fetched origin/main, so PRs are never born stale. Fail-open no-op for every other Bash call.

Blocks `gh pr create` when the diff changes a surface a human looks at and the body carries neither a figure nor a stated reason for having none. AGENTS.md asked for this in prose and the practice hollowed out anyway — a heading over an after-only capture reads as compliance. Fail-open no-op for every other Bash call, and for a body it cannot read.
After a successful `gh pr merge`, fast-forward the local main checkout so the next branch/worktree never starts from a stale base. No-op (silent exit 0) for every other Bash call.

After `git push` on a branch with an open PR, surfaces the PR title + latest commit subjects so the session verifies the title/body still describe the diff (the squash title is the release-notes line). Detection only — the session performs any gh pr edit.
